description: Authoritative Granblue Fantasy Supporter Summons Catalog, Grid Archetype mappings, attribute tab routing (1-7), and autonomous pre-battle supporter selection engine.

gridArchetypes.name: Magna / Omega (方陣)
gridArchetypes.description: Standard free-to-play grid archetype powered by Omega weapons. Scales exponentially with Omega aura multiplier (up to 170% at Lv 250).

gridArchetypes.name: Optimus / Primal (神石)
gridArchetypes.description: Gacha-intensive premium grid archetype powered by Grand weapons. Scales with Primal series aura multiplier (up to 170% at Lv 250).

gridArchetypes.name: Elemental / Flat Boost
gridArchetypes.description: Aura provides flat 150% elemental attack amplification; ideal for mixed grids, new accounts, or double-elemental burst setups.

gridArchetypes.name: One-Turn-Kill / Quick Summon Burst
gridArchetypes.description: Optimized for Turn 1 instant raids, leeching, and meat farming. Prioritizes 100% C.A. gauge (Huanglong) or 3M plain nuke + debuffs (Beelzebub).

gridArchetypes.name: Farming / Drop Boost / EXP
gridArchetypes.description: Boosts item drop rates (+25%), EXP (+30%), and Rupie gains for Pro Skips, Angel Halo, and daily scenario quests.
